svg.aria-label: The Warden Platform high level design: actors and touchpoints feed a deterministic transactional plane; the on-estate edge streams anonymised telemetry over MQTT into an advisory AI plane whose proposals cross a single deterministic decision gate before becoming audited actions; an eval harness verifies every model; external providers are reached only through Augur.

g.text: VON DIGITALIS ESTATES – HIGH LEVEL DESIGN (HLD)
deterministic · money, access, audit · governed, testable, repeatable
PAID · CONSENTED · PRICED → ISSUE SIGNED PASS
advice enters as a proposal · rules and policy are applied · an approved, audited action is emitted · the only bridge between the planes
non-deterministic · every model lives here · nothing here acts
provider-agnostic LLM gateway · the only route to a model · routing, caching, budget guard, circuit-breaker, fallback
verifies every advisory model continuously · shadow and canary before anything can influence the gate
SMS when the handset has no data
cards, refunds · never touched by a model
reached only through Augur · swappable by config
illustrative · two qualified + one self-hosted last resort
Lakehouse · years of history, offsite copy
only anonymised data crosses the boundary
classic test pyramid for deterministic code;
golden-set eval gate and human sign-off
quarterly drills; a missed drill blocks release
BUY / PAY · ASK GUIDE · DASHBOARDS · WHERE TO INVEST
CONFIRM / CORRECT · KEEPER AND VET VERDICTS, OPS OVERRIDES
every line is one edge of the master architecture
Advisory · AI output, proposals only, never acts
Telemetry from the estate · MQTT, anonymised
Feedback and evals · verdicts, labels, drift

Every arrow is an edge of the C4 master architecture. Money and access stay on solid navy lines; AI output travels on dotted peach lines and only becomes an action after it crosses the orange gate. Green dashed lines

are anonymised MQTT telemetry from the estate, lavender dotted lines are the feedback and eval loop, and gray lines are one-way external context. Provider marks under "Cloud LLM and ML" are illustrative: Augur routes
by policy and swapping a provider is a config change.
AI advises; rules and people decide
A prompt is a suggestion, a control is a control
Honesty about uncertainty is a constraint
Deliberate non-use is a decision too
Buy commodity AI, build domain AI
Every capability has a dumber fallback
Edge first, event driven, hub as system of record
Store and forward at every hop, QoS 1
CQRS read models, rebuildable from the log
Two planes with one governed bridge
Estate operates with the link down for weeks
Gate stays open offline on signed tickets
Two qualified providers plus a self-hosted model
Pinned model versions; a canary detects a swap
Hard spend ceilings with defined degradation
Kill switch reuses the drilled fallback
Quarterly drills; a missed drill blocks release
Earlier vet intervention, measured as lead time
A complete feeding record, not an impression
An honest piranha range, believed by keepers
Staffing where the crowd actually is
AI cost that is a formula, not a surprise
No path from a model to money or a gate
Source of truth: README.md and docs/diagrams/master-architecture.svg in the Warden repository (ZeCognito team). Icons: Lucide (ISC) and Simple Icons (CC0); brand marks belong to their owners.
